_note: Week of June 1–7, 2026. Mediterranean. Pita Tuesday = shrimp + pork tenderloin. Chicken swapped out of dinners where possible per Laine preference. Tzatziki appears on Pita Tuesday and is a standalone recipe. Laine waffle Sunday instead of pancakes.

tzatziki.name: Low-Fat Tzatziki
tzatziki.note: Jake's favourite. Makes about 1.5 cups — keeps 5 days in the fridge. Use on pitas, as a dip, alongside anything Mediterranean. Made with nonfat Greek yogurt so the fat is negligible.

ingredients.item: English cucumber — ½ large, grated and squeezed dry
Garlic powder — ½ tsp (or 1 small fresh clove, minced)
Dried mint — ½ tsp (optional but good)
Olive oil — 1 tsp drizzle on top for serving

steps: Grate cucumber on the large holes of a box grater. Transfer to a clean dish towel or paper towels and squeeze out as much liquid as you can — this is the key step. If you skip it the tzatziki will be watery.
Combine yogurt, squeezed cucumber, lemon juice, garlic powder, dill, mint, and salt. Stir well.
Taste and adjust — more lemon, more dill, more garlic. It should be bright and herby.
Cover and refrigerate at least 30 min before serving so the flavors meld.
Drizzle with a small amount of olive oil just before serving. Keeps 4–5 days covered in the fridge.

dinners.name: Lemon Herb Cod + Quinoa + Cherry Tomatoes
dinners.note: Clean Mediterranean opener. Cod baked in olive oil and lemon, quinoa for fiber, cherry tomatoes tossed in at the end. Simple and fast.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Pat cod dry, place in baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice, season with garlic powder, oregano, paprika, salt.
Bake 14–16 min until cod flakes easily.
Cook quinoa: rinse, simmer in 2× water 15 min, fluff. Jake 60g dry, Laine 50g dry.
Halve cherry tomatoes. Toss into warm quinoa with spinach — heat wilts the spinach.
Plate: quinoa base, cod on top. Squeeze extra lemon over everything.

dinners.name: Shrimp & Pork Tenderloin Pita Pockets with Tzatziki
dinners.note: Both are genuinely Mediterranean — shrimp is coastal Greek cooking, pork tenderloin is lean enough to work. Jake gets both proteins loaded in, Laine goes heavier shrimp. Tzatziki sauce makes it. Cook pork ahead or alongside shrimp — it's fast.

ingredients.item: Pork tenderloin — Jake 130g raw, Laine 80g raw
Frozen shrimp — Jake 120g raw, Laine 130g raw
Tzatziki — 3–4 tbsp per pita (see recipe card above)
Cherry tomatoes — ½ cup shared, halved
Garlic powder, oregano, smoked paprika, salt

steps: Make tzatziki ahead if you haven't (see recipe). It's better after 30 min in the fridge.
Slice pork tenderloin into thin medallions. Season with garlic powder, oregano, smoked paprika, salt.
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium-high. Sear pork 2–3 min per side until just cooked through — don't overdo it. Set aside.
In the same pan, cook shrimp with remaining seasoning 2 min per side. They go fast.
Warm pitas directly on the gas burner 30 sec per side, or in a dry pan.
Build pitas: generous spread of tzatziki, then pork + shrimp, then tomatoes, cucumber, spinach. Jake loads both proteins. Laine goes shrimp-forward.

dinners.name: Shrimp & Chickpea Skillet
dinners.note: Swapped chicken for shrimp per Laine preference. Shrimp + chickpeas + cherry tomatoes + spinach in one pan. Mediterranean and fast — 15 minutes total once the shrimp is thawed.

ingredients.item: Frozen shrimp — Jake 220g raw, Laine 180g raw

steps: Thaw shrimp in cold water 15 min. Pat dry.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Cook shrimp with garlic powder, oregano, cumin, salt — 2 min per side. Remove and set aside.
Add chickpeas to same pan. Warm 2–3 min, lightly pressing some with the back of a spoon.
Add cherry tomatoes, cook 2 min until blistered. Stir in spinach until wilted.
Return shrimp. Add lemon juice and toss everything together. Jake gets the bigger bowl.

dinners.name: Baked Salmon + White Rice + Wilted Spinach
dinners.note: Salmon Thursday. Omega-3 night. Jake bigger fillet. White rice for easy carbs, spinach wilted in lemon oil alongside. One of the simpler nights.

ingredients.item: Atlantic salmon fillet — Jake 180g raw, Laine 140g raw

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Brush salmon with olive oil, season with garlic powder, paprika, oregano, salt.
Bake 14–16 min. Let rest 2 min.
Cook rice per package. Jake 70g dry, Laine 75g dry.
Wilt spinach in a small pan with remaining oil and lemon over medium, 2 min.
Plate: rice base, salmon on top, wilted spinach alongside. Extra lemon to finish.

dinners.name: Cod + Cannellini Bean Skillet
dinners.note: Lean clean Friday. Cod on white beans with cherry tomatoes and spinach. Very coastal Mediterranean. The beans handle the carbs and fiber — no grain needed.

ingredients.item: Frozen cod — Jake 220g raw, Laine 160g raw

steps: Thaw cod, pat dry. Season with garlic powder, oregano, salt.
Heat olive oil over medium-high. Cook cod 3–4 min per side. Remove.
Add beans and tomatoes to pan. Warm 2 min, lightly crush a few beans.
Stir in spinach until wilted. Add lemon juice.
Plate bean mixture, cod on top. Big squeeze of lemon to finish.

dinners.name: Shrimp + Lemon Garlic Pasta
dinners.note: Weekend pasta. Olive oil and lemon, no heavy sauce — blistered cherry tomatoes, spinach, shrimp. Under 20 min. Jake bigger bowl, red pepper flakes on his side only.

ingredients.item: Frozen shrimp — Jake 220g raw, Laine 180g raw
Garofalo pasta — Jake 90g dry, Laine 75g dry
Garlic powder, oregano, salt — red pepper flakes for Jake

steps: Boil pasta in salted water al dente. Reserve ¼ cup pasta water. Drain.
Cook shrimp in olive oil over medium-high with garlic powder, oregano, salt — 2 min per side.
Add cherry tomatoes. Cook 2 min until blistered.
Add spinach until wilted. Toss in pasta + splash of pasta water. Squeeze lemon.
Jake gets bigger bowl with red pepper flakes. Serve immediately.

dinners.name: Birch Benders Waffle Night + Egg White Scramble
dinners.note: Standing Sunday breakfast-for-dinner. Waffles now instead of pancakes — same batter, better texture. Flaxseed in the batter. Thawed frozen fruit on top. Jake bigger stack.

ingredients.item: Birch Benders pancake/waffle mix — Jake ¾ cup, Laine ½ cup
Liquid egg whites — Jake ½ cup, Laine ¼ cup
Frozen mixed berries — ½ cup shared, thawed

steps: Thaw frozen fruit at room temp or microwave 60 sec.
Mix waffle batter: pancake mix + egg whites + water per pkg instructions. Stir in flaxseed.
Cook in a preheated waffle iron, 3–4 min or until steam stops and edges look crisp.
Jake gets bigger stack. Top both with thawed fruit.

jakeLunch.name: Chicken + Chickpea Bowl with Lemon Herb Sauce
jakeLunch.note: Mediterranean batch bowl. Same 5-container Sunday format. Chickpeas, lemon, garlic basil sauce, edamame. Still the workhorse.

ingredients.item: Chicken breast — 2.5 lbs total (227g raw per container)
Garbanzo beans — 2 cans total (0.4 can per container)
Garlic basil pasta sauce — 2.5 cups total (½ cup per container)
Frozen edamame (shelled) — 2.5 cups total (½ cup per container)
Frozen mixed veggies — 5 cups total (1 cup per container)

steps: Bake ALL chicken (2.5 lbs) at 400°F for 24 min. Cool and dice or shred.
Heat chickpeas in a pan with olive oil, garlic powder, cumin, salt — 5 min until slightly crispy.
Add pasta sauce, edamame, lemon juice. Simmer together 5 min.
Steam/microwave all frozen veggies separately.
Divide into 5 containers: chickpea + chicken mixture base, 1 cup veggies on top.
Drizzle with remaining lemon. Seal and refrigerate. Reheat 2 min with a splash of water.

laineLunch.name: Tuna & Shrimp Pasta Salad — Mason Jar Style
laineLunch.note: Bell pepper edition. Swapped some chicken for shrimp since Laine's not big on chicken. Still mason jar format, dressing separate, 2 sittings per jar.
laineLunch.dressingNote: Light Italian or Caesar — 2 tbsp per jar in a separate small container.

ingredients.item: Cooked shrimp — 100g per jar (thawed, patted dry)
Garofalo pasta (rotini or penne) — 250g dry total, 50g per jar
Canned tuna in water — 1 can per jar (5 cans total)
Bell pepper — 1 large diced, ~100g per jar
Baby spinach — big handful per jar (~30g)
Light Italian or Caesar dressing — 2 tbsp per jar, kept separate

steps: Cook shrimp in a pan with a little olive oil, lemon, garlic powder, salt — 2 min per side. Cool completely.
Cook pasta in salted water. Drain, rinse cold, toss with tiny bit of olive oil.
Dice bell pepper. Slice cucumber. Rinse spinach. Drain tuna well.
Layer each jar: pasta → tuna → cucumber → bell pepper → shrimp → spinach on top.
Dressing in a separate small container per jar. Refrigerate.
To eat: pour dressing in, shake, eat half — reseal for second sitting.

laineBreakfasts.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
steps: Spoon yogurt into bowl. Top with thawed berries and flaxseed.

laineBreakfasts.name: Egg White Scramble
steps: Sauté bell pepper in a small pan 2 min.
Add egg whites, scramble over medium-low until just set.
Toss in spinach at the end. Top with cheese.

laineBreakfasts.name: Birch Benders Waffles + Berries
laineBreakfasts.note: Waffles, not pancakes. Better texture, crispier edges. Same batter.

ingredients.item: Birch Benders pancake/waffle mix — ½ cup dry

steps: Mix waffle batter: mix + egg whites + water per pkg. Stir in flaxseed.
Cook in preheated waffle iron 3–4 min until crisp.
Top with thawed berries.
